# contextforge

> ⚒ Prompt compression with a receipt — forge lean LLM contexts and verify nothing important was lost. Zero-dependency Node + Railway deploy.

contextforge is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).

- [Landing page](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/contextforge/): overview, features, FAQ
